result.title: A Hybrid Framework for Explainable Aviation Risk: Causal Chain Extraction from Safety Reports with Physics-Based Failure Quantification and Interventional Analysis
result.summary: Aviation authorities hold decades of accident reports whose narratives record how investigators reconstructed each accident. Computational work on these archives has mostly sorted reports into fixed taxonomies. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework in which a text-based corpus identifies the leading factors of a failure mode. Physics-based models then quantify how likely that failure is at a stated operating point. Ordered causal chains extracted from 56,202 American accident reports with a local large language model aggregate into a causation knowledge graph. On an evaluation sample of 2,000 reports, the chains recover 90.8% of investigator-flagged causes. Each physical factor whose drivers the record carries receives an occurrence model calibrated to the accident population. A leaky noisy-OR fitted to the corpus combines the factors into a failure mode probability that supports intervention. For engine power loss, the carburetor icing model separates 1,205 icing accidents from other accidents using temperature and dewpoint alone, reaching 0.61 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve against a density ratio ceiling of 0.64. Routine weather hours give no valid control, because flying concentrates in fair weather. On later years the physics adds 0.03 to that area for occurrence and nothing for severity, so its value lies in interpretability. On four named accidents, abduction gives a probability of necessity of 0.29 to 0.50 for the heat omission, under monotonicity. The Fast Causal Inference algorithm does not license the largest backdoor adjustment on the learned networks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一个混合框架：用本地 LLM 从 56,202 份美国事故报告中抽取有序因果链并汇总为因果知识图谱，再由物理失效模型对给定工况下的失效概率进行量化，用 leaky noisy-OR 融合为可干预的失效模式概率，并进行必要性概率与后门调整分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将多因子贡献归因到单一失效结论、并用必要性概率与干预分析检验因果作用的做法，可能可供核查借鉴到 latent 推理中「中间状态或视觉证据对答案的因果贡献」这类问题；但论文对象是航空安全报告，与 VLM 推理无直接关联，属概念性启发。
